import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useCanReadFn } from "@/components/permissions-provider";
import { NAV, TOOLS_NAV, WORKSPACE_NAV, navItemReadable } from "@/components/shell/nav";

/**
 * The navigation this session may open (spec 2026-09-30-read-permissions):
 * a record or workspace set to No access is not offered. The pages are the
 * guard; this only keeps the sidebar, drawer and palette from pointing at a
 * "No access" page.
 */
export function useReadableNav() {
  const canRead = useCanReadFn();
  return useMemo(
    () => ({
      workspaces: WORKSPACE_NAV.filter((item) => navItemReadable(item, canRead)),
      records: NAV.filter((item) => navItemReadable(item, canRead)),
      tools: TOOLS_NAV.filter((item) => navItemReadable(item, canRead)),
    }),
    [canRead]
  );
}
